positioning.tool: WebSearch (standard mode); quotes are verbatim fragments returned in the search-result summaries of the listed sources

queries.query: distributed alignment search interchange intervention Geiger Finding alignments between interpretable causal variables and distributed neural representations
queries.source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2303.02536 (Geiger, Wu, Potts, Icard, Goodman; CLeaR 2024, PMLR 236)
queries.quote: DAS found perfect alignments for binary high-level variables tied to simple equality and lexical entailment
queries.verdict: Map class and interchange are DAS's; this artifact keeps the linear orthonormal map and adds the controls DAS papers did not run together (label derangements, random-init network, reverse, natural-variance projection).

queries.query: Makelov Lange Nanda Is this the subspace you are looking for interpretability illusion subspace activation patching
queries.quote: this can happen through a dormant parallel pathway that is causally disconnected from the output
queries.verdict: Directly predicts what we see at the rule-chosen decision blocks (Qwen L22, Gemma L16): subspace effects 3-8x the full-state patch, low natural-PC retention (c5) and failed reverse (c4).

queries.query: Sutter Minder Hofmann Pimentel non-linear representation dilemma causal abstraction randomly initialised language models
queries.quote: our alignment maps reach 100% interchange-intervention accuracy on the indirect object identification task
queries.verdict: Our c3 is their random-init test with a LINEAR map at a decision token: on Qwen3-8B T10 the random-init network still reaches 0.69 of the trained teacher-forced Delta, so the linear map alone does not certify a variable here either.

queries.query: MIB mechanistic interpretability benchmark Mueller 2025 causal variable localization DAS
queries.quote: SAEs features are not better than neurons, i.e., non-featurized hidden vectors
queries.verdict: MIB scores featurisers by IIA on held-out counterfactuals; we add its baseline set (DiM, PCA) at the same site and report that DAS beats them in teacher forcing while failing specificity controls MIB does not score.

queries.query: Boundless DAS Wu Geiger Interpretability at scale Alpaca causal mechanisms
queries.quote: Alpaca appears to solve the task by implementing a causal model with two interpretable boolean variables
queries.verdict: Boundless DAS reports robust alignments on an instruction-tuned 7B model; we find a strong algorithm-choice handle in Qwen3-8B and gemma-3-4b-it but not a variable that survives label and random-init controls.

queries.query: CDAS distribution-matching distributed alignment search bi-directional steering arXiv 2602.05234
queries.quote: CDAS adopts the same intervention protocol as DAS: DII, which naturally enables bi-directional steering
queries.verdict: We use its bounded distribution-matching idea (KL to the source's class distribution) and its bi-directional test (our reverse interchange c4), which fails at both decision sites.

queries.query: interchange intervention divergent representations causal interventions neural networks (found while searching DAS)
queries.quote: treats DAS as a form of activation patching performed in a transformed basis
queries.verdict: Concerned with interventions that push representations off the model's natural distribution; our OFF-MANIFOLD flag and c5 retention measure exactly that and fire at both decision sites.
